title: Chapter 6
text:
The Valkyrie's laboratory was disguised as a building on the ground. It was an abandoned farm. The fields were abandoned, and the roof tiles were broken. The farm was enclosed by an electrified wire fence, and there was only one gate. It was surrounded by an endless forest, and there were many broken buildings in the forest.

Nearby was a small city from the old civilization of Blue Star, but it was now abandoned.

A few decades ago, the Blue Star had connected with the interstellar forces and obtained all kinds of universal knowledge. They had entered the new civilization era, and the social environment had changed dramatically. Many cities were abandoned, and there was only a kind of post-apocalyptic atmosphere.

A Black Harrier helicopter landed on the abandoned farm. Six fully armed agents in black suits got off the helicopter. They were wearing black goggles, and their faces were cold. They were emitting a cold-blooded aura that prevented people from getting close to them.

"I'm the leader of the third Night Owl Squad, codename 'Silver Knife'. I'm here to transfer the Valkyrie's test subject team."

Silver Knife's tone was as cold as stone.

Hila combed her long hair that was blown up by the wind created by the wings of the helicopter. She said calmly, "Do whatever you want. There are off-road vehicles in the garage. I'm taking the helicopter. Don't waste my time."

Number One led the nine test subjects to Silver Saber. He held his head high and said, "Test subject Number One greets Sir!"

Silver Knife said coldly, "Come with us."

"Yes, sir!" No. 1 was so excited that his face turned red. Going to the headquarters for training was a supreme honor in his eyes.

The Night Owl Squad and the test subject team came to the garage and opened the camouflage forest green dust-proof cloth, revealing several high-horsepower bulletproof off-road vehicles. The two squads drove the vehicles out of the only gate and disappeared into the forest.

Hella got on the helicopter and flew away.

She suddenly felt uneasy. She had an ominous feeling.

"Strange, I feel like I've overlooked something." Hella frowned.

Today was the day that the leader allowed her to visit her sister, so Hella didn't think too much about it.

…

In the machinery modification room.

After installing the last hinge, Han Xiao put down the wrench and wiped the sweat on his forehead.

In front of him was a hollow exoskeleton mechanical arm. It looked like a large silver alloy arm. The outer armor was made of manganese steel alloy. This alloy was strong and hard, and was suitable for forging weapons and armor. In order to reduce weight and earthquake resistance, the inner part of the mechanical arm was made of light metal. All the parts were polished by the lathe in the modification room. The Germinal Organization's workshop and equipment were very advanced, and the parts were polished perfectly. These metals were all ready-made. Although the base had reduced the amount of materials in his machinery modification room, it was not difficult to find some good metals.

During the construction process, the left arm was used as a reference, and the left hand could be inserted into the mechanical arm to control it. With a flick of the finger, the hinge switch could be activated. The power came from the small engine and air pump hidden in the core of the mechanical arm. It was protected by layers of armor and could provide a lot of power.

The blueprint contained all the details of the production. Coupled with Han Xiao's own experience, the process from polishing, processing, and final assembly was very smooth.

From Han Xiao's perspective, the control system and power system of this Lightweight Mechanical Arm were rather outdated, and the materials used were also very ordinary. However, for the time being, this was already the best weapon he could build. It could be considered an excellent piece of equipment in the early stages, and the success rate of escaping would increase by at least twenty percent.

Moreover, he found that although making it himself was much more difficult than the loading bar of a game, it gave him more room to play freely. The advantages far outweighed the disadvantages.

Lightweight Mechanical Arm (Left)

[Quality: White]

Basic Parameters: Attack 35-58, Defense 13-17, Power Level 38, Durability 270/270

Equipment Requirements: 25 STR

Bonus Attribute: -3 SPD

Length: 51cm (Elbow + Forearm + Palm)

Weight: 14.7lbs

Additional Effect: + 10 STR increase.

The equipment level from low to high was divided into: Gray – Common, White – Normal, Green – Good, Blue – Good, Violet – Excellent, Pink – Rare, Orange – Legendary.

The interface notified him that he had completed the first production and gained 3,000 EXP. The rewards of creative work were much better than assembly and enhancement.

Han Xiao's current Strength was 21, so he spent four AP to reach the equipment requirement.

In the spare time on the lathe, Han Xiao used [Simple Enhancement Modification] to modify a Type 73 WASP. It had an Attack of 38-47, and it was much more powerful than the normal version. This was the first time he had fully enhanced a weapon. Of course, he would save the good stuff for himself. As long as he had enough bullets, this gun would be able to unleash its full potential. Han Xiao also used the leftovers from the mechanical arm to make a tactical dagger. The blade was mixed with tungsten steel, and it was very sharp with an additional ten Melee Attack. It would be a waste not to use the materials anyway.

Because Han Xiao had been keeping a low profile for a long time, there was no one watching him twenty-four hours a day. Han Xiao was the only mechanical support staff in the base. To be cautious, he first built the parts and then welded them together. The guards who occasionally glanced at the surveillance screen could not see what Han Xiao was building. They thought that he was repairing the gun as usual, so the process was very smooth.

Han Xiao hid the Lightweight Mechanical Arm and the Enhanced Wasp. His inventory was a real weight, not an extradimensional space. As the equipment was too eye-catching, he could not carry it around with him.

Han Xiao hid the dagger at his waist and walked out of the room. He went to the cafeteria in the basement.

When they had nothing to do, most of the agents would play cards here to pass the time. A lot of his intelligence came from the daily conversations of these agents. No one avoided him when they talked, so this gave him a chance to ask for more information.

As expected, pretending to be slow was a wise choice.

"I'm so jealous that Hella can leave the lab and stay in this shitty place every day. It's so boring."

"She's the executive officer of the organization. Her position is much higher than ours."

"Hella's face and body … If I could play with her for a night, I'd be willing to shorten my life by three years."

"Kid, you're new here, right? The last person who dared to challenge Hella didn't even have a single strand of hair left. How do you think she became the executive officer?"

"You mean … she's a superhuman?"

"Humph, of course."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. It was good news that he did not have to face Hella head-on. He did not have the slightest confidence that he could win against Hella.

He stood up and left the cafeteria without attracting any attention.

There were surveillance cameras in every corridor. If he wanted to escape, he would have to clear the surveillance room first.

The surveillance room was on the third floor. Han Xiao pretended to wander aimlessly as he approached the room. The armed guards he met along the way ignored him.

Two armed guards were guarding the door of the surveillance room, and there would be two more inside the room. In other words, it would not be easy to kill four guards quickly and silently. However, he had practiced this thousands of times in his mind, so he was not nervous at all.

There was a surveillance camera at the corner of the corridor. Han Xiao saw that there was no one around. He took out the leftover soft bread from breakfast, put it in his mouth, and soaked it with his saliva. He swung his hand and stuck it on the camera lens, blocking the image. He did not have any advanced hacking equipment, so he could only use this old method.

After waiting for three seconds, no one came out of the surveillance room. Han Xiao was surprised. He had heard the complaints of the guards on duty and their colleagues before. The base had never encountered any danger, so the guards on duty would not take it seriously and were all lazy.

Han Xiao calmed himself down and walked to the door of the surveillance room. Two armed guards extended their hands and stopped him.

"Unauthorized personnel are not allowed in."

"This is Zero. It's useless to talk to him. Just chase him away."

The guard on the left nodded and pushed Han Xiao's shoulder. Just when the two of them were completely unprepared, Han Xiao moved!

He twisted the wrist of the guard on the left and pulled out a tactical dagger from his waist with his other hand. He stabbed the dagger into the guard on the right through his head. The dull sensation of the dagger penetrating flesh was clearly transmitted from the handle to the guard's wrist!

The expression of the guard on the right froze on his face. He did not make a single sound before he died instantly.

Han Xiao released the dagger and pulled back his arm. Before the guard on the left could react, his head was in Han Xiao's arms. As a trained security personnel, the guard knew very well how fatal this position was. In a panic, he tried to pry Han Xiao's arm away.

In the next second, Han Xiao twisted with all his might. With a crack, the person in his arms stopped struggling.

It took less than a second to end two lives!

You have hit a critical point! Normal attack has been converted into a critical attack!

− 162 and − 171 light blue damage values appeared above the heads of the two guards. The critical attack damage was the maximum health of the target.

You have killed an armed guard of the Germinal Organization. You have received 360 EXP.

Grabbing the corpse and letting it fall silently, Han Xiao took a deep breath. He had actually simulated the swift and clean kill countless times in his mind.

Killing did not bring him any discomfort. He was secretly shocked. Is it because I've been too depressed recently that I've become a psychopath? In his previous life, the largest animal he had killed was probably a gutless rat in his hometown. Now, he felt no different from killing people. He urgently needed psychological treatment.

The interface prompted him to obtain the information of the two guards. Special Agent Level 7, Strength 10, END 15, Health Points 150. This was the standard of most of the armed guards in the laboratory. Individual Health Points were slightly different due to their physique.

You have received 4 pistol magazines.

Han Xiao found four WASP magazines on the two corpses. Holding the dagger in his hand, he quietly pushed open the door of the surveillance room.

Dozens of blue lights from the surveillance screens lit up the room. Han Xiao saw a scene that made him completely dumbfounded.

Three Hundred Thousand, who was on duty, and Constipation Bro were hugging each other intimately. Their lips were only a centimeter away from touching each other. When they heard the door open, they turned their heads in panic. The three of them were suddenly embarrassed, and the atmosphere was very stiff.

Han Xiao was dumbfounded. A mouthful of blood was stuck in his throat, unable to come up or go down.
